items.title: Lemon Nash Interview, 1959-10-03
items.q: Papa John. We've been practicing last week.

ctx.x: We can find him too, man. You know more people all over. Yeah. I got a fella right now, play bass with me.

He's 80 some years old. He's 88. I mean, play much rhythm as you want to hear. Papa John. We've been practicing last week. Remember, I got a nice little set up now, full pieces. John Joseph. Yeah, that's right. They call him Papa John.
